scope: Incremental LibreCAD consumer test with separately installed libdxfrw static archive on macOS ARM64.

consumer.configuration: Disposable source overlay and existing build directory, with the canonical LTYPE metadata hook and test added; exploratory modifications were also present in dxf_object_tests.cpp. CMake was changed to remove bundled libdxfrw compilation and link the installed libdxfrw::libdxfrw target.
consumer.privateHeaders: The SHP and JWW filters still obtain intern/drw_textcodec.h from the matching source overlay. This is not a public-headers-only build. The overlay lacks the later associative-prefix compatibility guard and emits switch warnings.

library.source: Library-bearing source as of c32a4dac; subsequent commits through 8f896cb0 change documentation, installation handling, or qualification metadata rather than compiled library sources.
library.linkProof: The test link command names the installed archive; the LibreCAD static archive contains no drw_objects, drw_entities, drw_base, libdxfrw or dwgbuffer object members.

environment: macOS 27.2.1 (26B131), Apple clang 21.0.0, ARM64, Release build, Qt offscreen
focusedResults: Canonical LTYPE application data: 1 case, 18 assertions passed.
Legacy LibreCAD DIMSTYLE groups: 1 case, 13 assertions passed.
limits: The consumer is modified and incrementally built, not a clean upstream build. No DWG consumer tests, other operating systems, full suite, ABI comparison, or public-headers-only integration were qualified. Source headers remain necessary for the two legacy filters. P8-A, P8-D and P8-E remain open and no support claim is promoted.
